statusText: Mapped policy state: CAUTION. Delayed NQ is holding near a fresh European-session high while oil, yields and U.S.-Iran escalation remain active amplifiers.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Tail is elevated during the current European opening window; later risk depends on whether near-high persistence survives meaningful retracements.
headline: European-session NQ high holding lifts Tail into elevated territory
body: Delayed NQ is 29,511.25 after reaching 29,527.50 from a 29,409.75 session low and remains near that high during Europe’s opening phase. The observed near-high hold adds persistence evidence, while Brent above $90, elevated Treasury yields and renewed U.S.-Iran fighting keep Stress extreme.

lookbackSummary: Tail held at 19% through 20:00 UTC on August 30, rose to 28% after renewed U.S.-Iran escalation, peaked at 30% at 01:00 UTC, then eased to 21–22% as meaningful retracements persisted before the current European-session recovery.
outlookSummary: Tail is 26% ELEVATED in the current European opening window because NQ is holding near a fresh session high. It falls toward WATCH if the opening move rotates; the U.S. cash open and Dallas Fed release are later conditional structure checkpoints.

forecast.analysis: Delayed NQ is 29,511.25 after reaching a fresh 29,527.50 session high from a 29,409.75 low. It is holding close to the high during Europe’s opening phase, adding observed persistence evidence, while the broader overnight path remains two-sided.

forecast.analysis: If Europe develops two-sided trade, Tail should ease within WATCH despite extreme Stress. Renewed near-extreme holding with weak counter-moves would be the main condition for re-escalation.
Midday Europe carries lower Tail if the opening move continues to mean-revert. Geopolitical and rate pressure can keep Stress extreme without implying a persistent NQ path.
Late Europe is a transition hour. Tail remains in WATCH unless a clean range break is followed by repeated extension and weak retracements as U.S. participation builds.
Ahead of the U.S. cash open, Tail rises conditionally if premarket direction becomes efficient and pullbacks stay shallow. A balanced premarket would keep the score below the block threshold.

forecast.analysis: The first cash hour overlaps the 14:30 UTC Dallas Fed release. Tail remains at WATCH unless post-open direction persists through meaningful counter-moves; the scheduled survey itself is not Tail evidence.

After the Dallas Fed checkpoint, Tail eases if price discovery stays orderly and counter-moves remain meaningful. A fresh catalyst plus repeated extension would be required to rebuild persistent-path risk.
U.S. midday trading is projected to carry lower Tail absent fresh extremes. Cross-asset pressure matters most if NQ itself begins holding direction while pullbacks repeatedly fail.
If midday rotation persists, Tail stays near the lower WATCH band. A new one-way leg would require NQ price-path confirmation rather than headline importance alone.
Early afternoon remains conditional on whether the cash-session range expands or rotates. Meaningful retracements would keep Tail contained despite elevated event Stress.
Late-session Tail rises modestly if an established trend accelerates into the close. Repeated extension and weak pullbacks would be required for a stronger persistence signal.
Around the cash close, Tail stays in WATCH if directional pressure remains unresolved. A closing reversal or deeper counter-move would reduce the probability of a persistent path.
After the cash close, Tail eases if after-hours trading is orderly. Fresh military or shipping headlines remain Stress amplifiers but would need price-path confirmation to lift Tail.
The next Globex reopen creates a new price-discovery window. Tail stays in WATCH only if a gap develops and persists with shallow retracements; a balanced reopen would favor lower risk.
Early Globex Tail is projected lower if the reopen remains balanced. A sustained break from the new session range with failed counter-moves would be the principal conditional amplifier.
Asia’s early handoff keeps Tail near WATCH while the geopolitical backdrop remains unresolved. The score would rise only if NQ couples a fresh directional break with weak counter-moves.
Tail moves into LOW if Asian trading remains two-sided and no new discontinuity appears. Stress may stay extreme even while persistence risk declines.
The conditional path remains LOW if session extremes do not hold and retracements stay meaningful. A fresh one-way extension would invalidate that assumption.
Late Asia carries lower Tail under a stable-range assumption. Confidence is lower at this horizon, and any new verified catalyst would require reassessment rather than being presumed.
Ahead of Europe, Tail remains LOW if overnight structure is balanced. A new directional gap into the European handoff would be the main condition for a WATCH state.

The next European pre-open is a conditional WATCH checkpoint because unresolved Gulf risk can reprice across sessions. Tail reaches 22% only if the handoff shows renewed directional structure rather than rotation.

forecastDetail.comment: Delayed NQ is holding near a fresh session high during Europe’s opening phase; observed continuation plus current macro/geopolitical amplifiers lift Tail into ELEVATED.
If near-high holding and shallow pullbacks persist, Tail stays elevated; a rotation through the European opening range would lower it.
After the opening range forms, meaningful counter-moves would return Tail to WATCH; failed retracements after a fresh extreme would keep it near the threshold.
Two-sided European trade would lower Tail within WATCH even while Gulf and rate stress remain extreme.
Midday rotation would keep Tail in lower WATCH; renewed near-extreme holding with weak counter-moves is the main escalation condition.
Late Europe remains transitional; repeated extension after a clean range break would be required for materially higher Tail.
